content: For each configured TcpIpSocketOwner TcpI p shall provide a separate TcpIp_<Up>GetSocket API by replacing the tag <Up> with the short name of the TcpIpSocketOwner container. Sockets allocated by a dedicated TcpIp_<Up>GetSocket API shall be assigned exclusively to the respective upper layer .
